articles.title: UK Social Media Ban for Under-16s: Unanswered Questions on Roblox, YouTube, and More
articles.summary: The UK announced a sweeping social media ban for under-16s, but key details are missing. Will Roblox be included? How will YouTube enforce it? The government says more rules are coming in July, leaving millions of kids in limbo.

articles.title: Survey Reveals Working Parents' Constant Struggle: 'No Way to Be Two Things at Once'
articles.summary: A Pew Research Center survey of 2,242 working parents finds that most feel torn between job and family. Two-thirds of working moms and half of dads say they can't give 100% at home, highlighting the need for better support.

articles.title: Three Reasons Ships Aren't Sailing Through the Strait of Hormuz Despite Trump's Announcement
articles.summary: President Trump declared the Strait of Hormuz 'open' after a deal with Iran, but over 250 tankers remain trapped in the Gulf. Security threats, sea mines, and deep mistrust are keeping captains from risking the passage.
